authority: Frozen policy settings plus original decision rubric; parser-specific behavior is explicitly labelled legacy profile, not an independently justified operational requirement.

rules.name: structural_contract
rules.predicate: Input satisfies the frozen Python contract profile and bounded JSON ingress; no implicit schema-only equivalence.
rules.reason_scope: parser-specific reason codes; separately specified witnesses

rules.name: identity_binding
rules.predicate: Out-of-band principal exists, equals claimed agent ID, is registered, and registered role equals claimed role.

rules.name: role_action_permission
rules.predicate: Claimed action is permitted to the declared role; identity binding must also pass.

rules.name: interface_action_permission
rules.predicate: Action uses the interface listed in the action table.

rules.name: target_type
rules.predicate: Target type equals the declared action target type; this does not authenticate target identity or dependency mapping.

rules.name: protected_service
rules.predicate: A disruptive action must not declare slice-emergency or slice-public-safety. Non-disruptive actions are outside this rule.

rules.name: exact_parameter_contract
rules.predicate: Parameter key set and control_parameter equal the action table exactly; bounded numeric fields satisfy inclusive limits and exclude booleans.

rules.name: minimum_risk
rules.predicate: Risk rank is at least the action minimum.

rules.name: bounded_lifetime
rules.predicate: ttl_seconds <= 900 and elapsed age <= ttl_seconds; structural TTL must first be a true integer in [1,86400].

rules.name: rollback_declaration
rules.predicate: Disruptive actions declare rollback.available=true and non-whitespace procedure; no execution or adequacy of that procedure is verified.

rules.name: active_state_and_conflict
rules.predicate: Malformed active input or another structurally valid action matching interface,target_type,target_id,control_parameter requires escalation. Same action_id is exempt. Timestamps and approvals of active actions are not re-evaluated.

rules.name: trusted_current_approval
rules.predicate: High/critical risk or an approval-required action has a present approved registry entry bound to exact proposal, principal, role and expiry, with expires_at strictly later than evaluation time.

rules.name: decision_combination
rules.predicate: Any hard violation gives DENY; otherwise any escalation condition gives ESCALATE; otherwise ALLOW. Final reasons belong to the winning severity; first active-state issue may determine the conflict reason.
rules.reason_scope: POLICY_CHECKS_PASSED only when no violation applies

known_limitations.description: Evidence references do not verify incident truth, necessity or benefit.
Declared slice and target fields are simulated, not authoritative dependency mappings.
rollback_policy is not disruptive; protected-service and rollback-declaration gates do not apply. User chose preservation and disclosure.
Same action_id active entries are ignored even if content differs; no cumulative disruption or indirect-conflict guarantee.
Structurally valid active state is not checked for lifecycle expiry or reauthorized.
snapshot_id and message require named keys but have no additional type, nonempty or existence checks beyond generic JSON constraints.
JSON Schema and Python parser accepted profiles differ; no cross-language contract equivalence claim.
Audit checksum is not a signature or immutable external log; approval/identity services are offline fixtures.
Optional structurally valid approval is not verified when action and risk do not require approval.
